research_notes: The final policy should expose its evidence version/date so future workers know which cap assumptions they inherited.
If runtime behavior changes, a new validation epoch can supersede the old cap without deleting history.
This is preferable to treating one experimental result as permanent platform truth.
Rollback can temporarily select a lower previously validated cap while revalidation runs.
The current study is establishing the first such evidence base.
No permanent cap has yet been promoted.
